svg.title: Overview map of Sydney, Fremantle, Trincomalee, Aden and Suez; connectors are schematic.
svg.desc: Bernard Shambrook’s diary. Approximate reference places, not exact personal positions. Coastline: Natural Earth. No political boundaries. Dashed lines, where shown, are schematic sequence connections.
svg.text: Approximate reference places · Modern coastline: Natural Earth · No political boundaries
